name: Triumph America / Speedmaster
engine: 790 or 865 cc air-cooled parallel twin, carbs then fuel injection
intro: The cruiser versions of the modern Bonneville. Carbs on early bikes, fuel injection from about 2008.

G: Check which you have. Carbureted bikes get the carb steps; fuel-injected bikes skip them.

recallNote: Triumph has issued recalls on some bikes in these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
